dedupe_keys.name: tajikistan ministry of energy and water resources monthly vakhsh river flow and reservoir data rogun nurek

description: The Ministry of Energy and Water Resources of Tajikistan publishes a page of mean monthly values of the Vakhsh river flow distribution, with one table per month for 2025 and 2026 (January 2025 to August 2026 when read). Each table gives the monthly inflow to and release from the Rogun and Nurek hydropower reservoirs in million cubic metres, reservoir volume at the start and end of the month (and Nurek water level), withdrawals by the Vakhsh and Shurobod main canals, the Yavan-Obikiik irrigation system, the Garauti pumping station and other intakes in cubic metres per second and million cubic metres, and discharge and flow volume at the Tigrovaya Balka gauge. Coverage is the Vakhsh river basin, a main tributary of the Amu Darya. Access is free as HTML tables with no sign-in. Caveats: values are monthly means, the tables are in Russian, and some cells in the Nurek volume rows are misaligned. Simulation uses: reservoir operation and water allocation between hydropower and irrigation in a transboundary basin. Related records: Kariba reservoir levels and flows (data-zra-kariba-lake-levels-reservoir-river-flows) and the Global Runoff Data Centre (data-grdc-global-runoff-database).
